formula: float32(base + float32(growth * float32(level))); current explicit HP wins; exact C1 retained; otherwise exact historical enum reuse; otherwise region/role median or declared global anchor; original finite raid maps use raid-specific public estimates/local same-mode role medians before historical or ordinary regional models.
scope: Current finite static and native-whitelisted NPC initialization only; player sentries/pets and active actor HP are excluded. No fixed500/5000 fallback. Same finite policy applies to native solo/party initialization; no invented party or boss-gauge multiplier.
known_limits: Exact historical enum reuse is a local numeric rule, not proof of same current retail template balance.
Region/role model cannot reproduce undisclosed species/elite/mode distinctions. Natural battle and balance remain unverified.
Special relative/event source-level gaps use the already pinned route NPC level as an explicitly local initialization input; no player-identity inference.
Raid estimated HP is not current official CN data or natural combat balance. Residual difficulty scripts are preserved without granting new access.
